name_en: Chicken chicken gobo — bite-size fried chicken and burdock in a sweet soy glaze
summary_ja: 一口大の鶏の唐揚げと素揚げごぼうを甘辛いたれで絡める学校給食発の一皿。1995年ごろ、家庭のレシピを募って栄養教諭が考案したとされ、口ずさみやすい名前とともに県民食として広まったと伝わる。
summary_en: Bite-size fried chicken and deep-fried burdock are tossed in a sweet soy glaze in this dish, born in Yamaguchi's school lunches. A nutrition teacher is said to have devised it around 1995 from recipes submitted by families, and its catchy, rhythmic name helped it spread into a statewide favorite.
source_title: チキンチキンごぼう 山口県

name_en: Fugu no karaage — deep-fried pufferfish, a homely counterpart to fugu sashimi
summary_ja: しょうゆや酒で下味をつけたふぐを片栗粉で揚げる下関・萩の家庭料理。刺身や鍋には高級なトラフグが使われる一方、唐揚げには安価なシロサバフグが使われることが多いと伝わる。
summary_en: Pufferfish, marinated in soy sauce and sake, is coated in potato starch and deep-fried—a homely dish from the Shimonoseki and Hagi areas. While pricier tiger pufferfish goes into sashimi and hot pot, the more affordable shirosabafugu species is the one most often fried this way.
source_title: ふぐの唐揚げ 山口県

name_en: Kujira no tatsutaage — whale meat marinated and fried, a former school-lunch staple
summary_ja: しょうゆやみりん、しょうが汁に漬け込んだクジラの赤身を片栗粉で揚げる山口の一皿。戦後の学校給食の定番として広く親しまれ、下関や長門など捕鯨で栄えた地域では今も飲食店の逸品と伝わる。
summary_en: Whale meat, marinated in soy sauce, mirin, and ginger juice, is coated in potato starch and fried in this Yamaguchi dish. It became a beloved staple of postwar school lunches nationwide, and in whaling towns like Shimonoseki and Nagato it remains a standout on restaurant menus.
source_title: くじらの竜田揚げ 山口県
